proposals.evidence: DEDR4572 gives Malayalam pōka go and Kannada pō/hōgu/ōgu, with southern pō-/pōk-/pōy- alternants. The survey simple and participial forms preserve that going family; responses combining movement verbs or auxiliaries are excluded. The paired elicitation gloss is retained even where this individual source record contains only the bare/imperative or inflected verb; no absent clause is reconstructed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
